blocks.text: Annual Operations Review

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The quarterly review found that throughput improved across every region while operating cost stayed flat. Field engineers reported fewer interruptions and a shorter mean time to recovery.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: A second pass confirmed the result. The committee asked for a written summary before the next planning cycle so that the assumptions could be checked against the original forecast.
